notes:
- Fixed Host being assigned another player's or AI lord's region and settlement when loading an existing co-op save (Host now always re-possesses their own lord pawn, camera, HUD, and region on multi-human saves, even when launching solo or before teammates join, and silences other human pawns cleanly)
- Fixed Saved Game lobby wizard and Active Lobby not auto-selecting your original region (sidecar .coop.json now preserves canonical map catalog region IDs alongside UE5 region tags, auto-heals existing .coop.json saves on read with no re-save needed, resolves local sidecars for Steam Cloud saves, and displays reserved teammate pins accurately)
- Fixed unmatched players on saved games without a sidecar hijacking a settled AI opponent's town/buildings (pick_saved_lord_candidate now matches returning players on human slots by name/region first and spawns a fresh lord in an open region instead of taking over an AI lord)
- Includes all v1.0.21 fixes: simultaneous Host+Client corpse-burial save crash guard (coopnative v0.8.10), Client 24-man Retinue rally/command fix, and self-contained Multiplayer portal runtime
